title: Provide native scoped keyword results and supported catalog

gates.name: Focused Docker package tests
gates.command: docker run --rm --network none -v "$PWD:/src" -w /src somon-price-hotfix-builder:latest sh -c 'CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -count=1 ./internal/somon ./internal/htmlx'

verify.summary: Independent reviewer httptest outcome probe and required network-disabled focused Docker tests passed: all 16 native scopes/q/relevance, primary-only IDs, confirmed-zero versus errors, typed 403/429, passive fields and rental regression. Authorized representative fixtures; no live compatibility claim. Co-review launch attempted but agent thread limit reached; status unchanged, closure owner /root.

purpose: Return the native scope primary feed without foreign-region recommendations or false successful emptiness.
success_outcome: Confirmed category/city + encoded q/relevance produces primary-only cards, a confirmed empty result or an error.
anti_goals: Do not implement saved-search UI/storage, strict price eligibility, keyword scheduling or delivery.
Do not change rental parse/sanity behavior, add date ordering, crawler/pagination or blocking bypass.

forbidden_scope: commit, push, deployment, production runtime and production DB
real Telegram messages, secrets or allowlist/target-chat policy changes
FT-001..004 outcomes/task records/statuses/approvals; unrelated rental UI or fallback changes
direct SQLite writes outside Persistence Adapter; business orchestration in transport/composition
stop_conditions: An unresolved material product/contract/state/ownership branch is discovered.
Required scope changes task identity/tier/dependency/owned claims or affects production.
Honest compiling behavioral RED or preserved initial GREEN cannot be obtained for an owned claim; syntax/setup failure is not RED.

constraints: Primary owner: Somon Adapter (internal/somon); passive fields: Shared Data (internal/model). Catalog is source-owned; no price/business/history decision here.
Reuse existing Go/CGO clients, scheduler, SQLite and test harness; expected paths are advisory.
Dependencies own their proof; current regression checks do not adopt their claims.
Use only local httptest endpoints and t.TempDir DB; network-disabled Docker gate uses existing builder image.
invariants: Rental data/behavior retain their existing owners; independent search IDs/history never use rental seen_ads as exclusion.
Admin allowlist, target-chat policy, callback acknowledgement and append-only output are preserved in new routes.
verification_targets: FT-005-AC-003 (REQ-011/013): reuse parser/client httptest harness and source-backed primary/nonempty/small/zero pages with recommendation markers, blocked page and malformed body. Compare primary IDs, zero success/error and captured native request path/q/ordering for All/categories and country/city. Initial catalog exactly matches canonical paths and keys.

FT-005-AC-003: before production changes run existing ParseCategory/FetchCategory against the same captured source fixtures; primary contamination or zero error is behavioral RED. Preserve already-correct URL encoding/transport outcomes as initial GREEN. New API symbol compilation failures never count. Afterward probe the new source entrypoint with the same fixtures and request expectations; preserve rental/price fixtures.

Use checked-in sanitized public HTML fixtures with provenance to documented native URLs; do not invent DOM selectors or empty markers. No local fixtures from blocked responses may be called successful HTML. Safe rerun uses fresh httptest server, unchanged fixtures and captured in-memory requests; close server on cleanup.
evidence_required: FT-005-AC-003 — RED: existing category parser returns foreign-region recommendation IDs or fails a confirmed zero-primary page. GREEN: exact primary IDs/confirmed zero succeed; malformed/blocked bodies remain errors; captured requests use selected native category/city, q and relevance. Decisive comparison: expected ID set, empty/error class and request fields, with each subcase distinguished; preserve any pre-implementation GREEN. Artifact: .tasks/TASK-006-T2-FT-005-W1/TASK-006-T2-FT-005-W1-acceptance-evidence.md.
